name: Live System Metrics Dashboard
summary: Simulated real-time system metrics dashboard with auto-updating AreaChart showing CPU usage over a rolling 60-second window, Progress bars for Memory, Disk, and Network utilization, KPI counters with Badge status indicators, and Skeleton loading states on initial render. Uses lodash _.throttle for update throttling and _.meanBy for CPU average computation.
shortSummary: Live-updating system metrics dashboard with CPU chart and resource monitors

LiveMetrics.summary: Real-time system metrics dashboard with auto-updating AreaChart (CPU over 60s), Progress bars (memory, disk, network), KPI cards (requests/sec, connections, error rate), Badge status indicators, and Skeleton loading states
